raw_source.title: Virtuals-Protocol 正在招聘高级智能合约开发工程师（Solidity 开发工程师）。 Virtuals-Protocol 是一家总部位于新加坡的公司。 远程办公岗位。 全职或兼职均可。 薪资：每月 9000 ~ 16000 美元。
raw_source.body:
## 公司/团队介绍
Virtuals is building the permissionless economy for autonomous agents, open rails for AI agents to earn, transact, hold capital, build reputation, and operate businesses. 
https://www.linkedin.com/company/virtualsprotocol/

## 薪资福利待遇
 薪资：每月 9000 ~ 16000 美元。

## 地点

- 工作地点：Singapore
- 联系方式：
joey@virtuals-protocol.biz
Telegram : @sapphire_hr
## 工作性质

- 是否全职：Full-time or Part-time
- 是否远程：Remote role
- 时区要求 : GMT+8
  
## 岗位要求、职责
Design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable smart contracts that support autonomous agent transactions, economic coordination, and on-chain services. Collaborate with AI and infrastructure teams to integrate contracts across the platform, and contribute to testing, audits, and ongoing security improvements.

## 工作环境
This is a fully remote role
raw_source.author: marius-stander
